users-role#1 GET /api/users?role=agent: legacy returned 500: the role filter was bound to $1 but never passed to the query. Fixed (spec §6.1).
leads-list-agent#1 GET /api/leads: agent visibility: an agent now also sees leads ASSIGNED to them (and ones they collaborate on), not only leads they created (spec §6.2).
leads-list-agent-assignedonly#1 GET /api: same fix: assigned_only returned [] for an agent because it was ANDed with owner_id = me (spec §6.2).
board-agent#1 GET /api/leads/pipeline: agent visibility: the kanban now includes leads assigned to the agent (spec §6.2).
agent-sees-assigned#1 GET /api/leads/7: agent visibility: 403 'Not yours' -> 200 for a lead the agent is assigned to (spec §6.2).
enrich-preview-agent#1 GET /api/leads/en: agent visibility: preview rows include leads assigned to the agent (spec §6.2).
queue-agent#1 GET /api/leads/call-queue: agent visibility: the call queue shows the agent's ASSIGNED leads; legacy showed only leads they created (spec §6.2).
calls-stats-agent#1 GET /api/calls/stats: agent visibility: total_leads counts every lead the agent may see (1 -> 10 here) instead of only leads they created (spec §6.2).
an-command-agent#1 GET /api/analytics/co: RBAC: Command Centre is a manager-level page; the API now enforces the page permission (default: agents denied) instead of only hiding the sidebar link (spec §6.9).
report-email#1 POST /api/reports/generat: legacy ALWAYS returned 500: it inserted into daily_reports, a table no migration ever created. Table added (migration 2_daily_reports) (spec §6.12).
tpl-create-vars#1 POST /api/whatsapp-tem: legacy saved the row, then returned 500 because it ran JSON.parse on an already-parsed JSONB value. Now 201 with the variables (spec §6.13).
exp-calls-noparams#1 POST /api/exports: legacy read params.limit with params undefined -> TypeError -> 500. params now defaults to {} (spec §6.14).
exp-leads#1 POST /api/exports: legacy bound the wrong number of query parameters -> 500 for every 'leads' export. Fixed; agents export only leads they may see (spec §6.14).
exp-pipeline#1 POST /api/exports: legacy referenced $2 without passing it -> 500 for every non-agent 'leads_pipeline' export; also used a hard-coded status list. Now one row per configured pipeline stage (spec §6.14).
exp-unknown#1 POST /api/exports: legacy wrote nothing for an unknown type and crashed (500). Now 400 with the allowed types (spec §6.14).
exp-injection#1 POST /api/exports: legacy interpolated the request's order/dir into the SQL (injection). They are now matched against a whitelist (spec §6.14).
exp-list#1 GET /api/exports: consequence of the export fixes: the previously failing exports now exist and are listed (spec §6.14).
sys-root-json#1 GET /: landing page no longer advertises the non-existent GET /api/version and no longer hard-codes a server IP in the docs link (spec §6.15).
sys-version#1 GET /api/version: unknown routes now return JSON {detail} 404 instead of Express's HTML error page (spec §6.4).
status-rules#1 GET /api/leads/status-rul: the formula text now describes the sheet’s real rules (bonus on overdue OR due today; Cool / Won tiers) and two next-action texts match the sheet exactly (spec §6.16, §6.17).
imp-preview#1 POST /api/leads/import/pre: preview now reports date_order: what the file’s slash dates prove, so the wizard can ask when they are ambiguous (spec §6.18).
imp-commit-token#1 POST /api/leads/impor: phone cleaning follows the sheet (last 10 digits, trunk 0 dropped), so 09820011111 is now recognised as a duplicate of +91 98200 11111 instead of being unusable; a row with a phone but no name is imported (spec §6.19, §6.20).
imp-commit-file-again#1 POST /api/leads/: same as imp-commit-token (phone cleaning / duplicate recognition).
imp-xlsx-commit-sheet2#1 POST /api/leads: the skip message now reads “no customer, pharmacy or phone on the row”: a row is only dropped when it has none of the three (spec §6.20).
enrich-preview#1 GET /api/leads/enrichme: engine changes: tier Cool/Won, bonus on due-today, duplicate next action, corrected phone cleaning (spec §6.16, §6.19).
an-command#1 GET /api/analytics/command-: engine changes flow through (tiers, scores, next-action text) (spec §6.16).
an-daily#1 GET /api/analytics/daily-repo: “called” counted every lead whose call_done was not NULL, i.e. also the ones stored as ‘false’; it now counts only true / has a call date, matching the sheet’s “Calls Done” (spec §6.21).
an-area#1 GET /api/analytics/area-analys: same “called” fix as the daily report (spec §6.21).
queue#1 GET /api/leads/call-queue: a lead nobody has called is Cool (live, below Warm), not Closed (spec §6.16).
queue-telecaller#1 GET /api/leads/call-q: a recognised duplicate keeps its score but its action becomes “Duplicate – skip”, and 09820011111 now cleans to a phone that duplicates another lead (spec §6.16, §6.19).
leads-list-after-import#1 GET /api/leads: list rows carry the engine columns (tier, next action, window…) and the imported rows differ per the import changes above.
